issues.title: Shared kernel: errors, pagination, transactions, logging
issues.body:
**Owner:** Baraa · **Due:** Sat 17 Oct 2026 · **Phase:** P1 Foundations
**Depends on:** #4

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Global ProblemDetails filter (RFC 9457 + code + traceId); PostgreSQL errors mapped: 23505 → 409, 23503 → 409, 23514 → 422
- [ ] ValidationPipe returns the errors[] array from the design
- [ ] Pagination DTO and Page<T>; size capped at 100
- [ ] UUIDv7 ids, injectable Clock, request ID + pino logging with redaction
- [ ] @Transactional via nestjs-cls with the Drizzle adapter; optimistic-lock helper (UPDATE … WHERE version = $n RETURNING → 412 on 0 rows); after-commit event dispatcher
- [ ] A reference repository adapter other modules can copy
- [ ] Unit tests for every helper
- [ ] @nestjs/swagger configured at /api/docs (disabled in production) with bearer auth
- [ ] An npm script writes openapi.json; CI uploads it as an artifact on every PR

### Definition of done
- [ ] Tests for the new behaviour pass in CI
- [ ] New endpoints have Swagger decorators; writes are audited
- [ ] Reviewed by Baraa and squash-merged
